stories.title: Zero hours workers could get guaranteed contracts — here is what the consultation proposes
stories.summary: Workers on zero hours contracts could be entitled to guaranteed hours and paid compensation for cancelled shifts under government reforms now out for consultation. stories.title: Paedophile who abused two children in Connah’s Quay jailed for life at Mold Crown Court
